context:
Check the existing nyctaxi query structure for override patterns. Create
clickhouse_sql/ subdirectory with 3 query files using ClickHouse-native
date/time functions. The SQL logic stays the same; only the function calls change.
description:
12 query failures across nyctaxi on ClickHouse due to unsupported EXTRACT variants:
- rush-hour-analysis: EXTRACT(HOUR FROM ts) and EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM interval)
- weekday-weekend-comparison: EXTRACT(DOW FROM ts)
- trips-by-day-of-week: EXTRACT(DOW FROM ts)

ClickHouse equivalents:
- EXTRACT(HOUR FROM ts) → toHour(ts)
- EXTRACT(DOW FROM ts) → toDayOfWeek(ts) % 7
- EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (ts2 - ts1)) → dateDiff('second', ts1, ts2)

Part of Pattern B (EXTRACT rewrite) which also affects coffeeshop.

anti_patterns.why: other platforms depend on standard SQL EXTRACT

anti_patterns.dont: use toDayOfWeek() directly as DOW replacement
anti_patterns.why: ClickHouse returns 1=Monday while SQL standard DOW is 0=Sunday

preserves.behavior: Base nyctaxi queries unchanged - other platforms use standard EXTRACT syntax
Override queries return identical column names, types, and row semantics

verifications.command: uv run -- python -m pytest tests/ -v -k 'nyctaxi and clickhouse'
verifications.description: ClickHouse nyctaxi overrides load and use native date functions

work_units.summary: Create ClickHouse override for rush-hour-analysis query using toHour() and dateDiff('second', ...)
Create ClickHouse override for weekday-weekend-comparison using toDayOfWeek() % 7
Create ClickHouse override for trips-by-day-of-week using toDayOfWeek() % 7
Verify all 3 overrides are loaded correctly by the query manager
